# What should your Starter, Pro and Team plans cost?

> Free SaaS pricing tool: paste what surveyed customers would pay for each plan and get the Good-Better-Best prices that earn the most profit, who lands on each plan, and what you gain over your current prices. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
